messages:
elena: FYI we just got an enterprise escalation (JIRA-1203) — multiple customers in eu-west reporting SSO failures after IdP pushed a new cert ~2h ago. 403 on login, logs show signature verify error.

sam: can you paste a short log?

elena: minimal server log from the edge: 
```
2026-03-17T09:12:03Z ERROR saml: signature verification failed: key id not found
request_id=abc123 tenant=acme
recipient=https://app.redwood.com/sso/acs
```

michael: most likely a metadata propagation issue. Are our metadata-fetcher polls picking up the new IdP feed?

elena: fetcher shows new metadata fetched from idp at 09:05 but the edge caches still return the old cert when we curl through the CDN. repro: `curl -I https://metadata.acme-idp.com/saml.xml` from eu edge returns 304 with cache headers TTL 600s.

ops_jen: tagging eng-sre, this looks like an origin->edge cache window where the IdP rotated cert, feed returned 200 from origin but CDN served 304 and kept old body. Could be our metadata watcher using If-Modified-Since and not validating fingerprint change.

sam: quick mitigation: we can force a metadata refresh for the affected tenants (bypass the If-Modified-Since for their poll) and add old cert as a fallback for 1h in our verifier. Do we want to do both? :thinking_face:

elena: customer asked for rollback option too. I prefer: 1) force-refresh poll for tenant, 2) temporarily accept previous signing key thumbprint for 30m, 3) update our docs to recommend IdP set cache-control short during rotations.

michael: agree. Steps I propose: 
- run `metadata-fetcher --tenant acme --force-poll` on control plane (will push to config service)
- signal edge to invalidate metadata cache: `edgectl purge /metadata/acme/* --region eu-west`
- apply verifier fallback: add thumbprint XXXXXX to tenant temporary allowed list via console API `PATCH /tenants/acme/saml-config` payload `{ "fallback_key_thumbprint": "XXXXXX", "expires_at": "2026-03-17T10:00:00Z" }`

ops_jen: I can run the purge and force-poll, will coordinate with infra. When done I'll post evidence (curl + sha256 of metadata).

elena: customer rep wants a brief message to reassure them. Proposed: "We observed a short metadata propagation window during your IdP certificate rotation. We've forced a refresh and applied a temporary verifier fallback; you should be able to log in now. We'll follow up with permanent fix recommendations."

support-bot: created internal incident INC-4521 and linked JIRA-1203. Notifying oncall.

ops_jen: done steps: force-poll returned 200 at 09:24, edge purge completed 09:25. curl from eu-west now returns 200 and SHA256: `b94f9e...` (matches new cert fingerprint).

michael: removing fallback in 35m. Please confirm customer can login before then. Also we should add a short-term change to the poller: if metadata `Last-Modified` changes but fingerprint differs, treat as immediate update (don't accept 304 caching). I'll open a follow-up ticket.

elena: customer confirmed success at 09:28, said login works. Marking as triaged and escalating follow-up to eng-sre for fix.

sam: thanks team. Follow-up tasks: small poller logic patch + doc note for customers on rotation best practices (cache-control: no-cache during rotation window). I'll draft PR. :thumbsup:

ops_jen: leaving logs/snippets in INC-4521. closing immediate escalation.

elena: great, closing thread here.
